PRIMARY_REASONER.purpose: ambiguous or consequential decisions, reverse strategy, structural safety decisions, L3 review, and final acceptance

LOW_COST_EXECUTION_WORKER.purpose: bounded L1/L2 execution, verification commands, cleanup, rollback, and concise receipts

READ_ONLY_VERIFIER.purpose: fast read-only risk classification, diff/config checks, scope checks, and L2 review packets

ESCALATION_REVIEWER.purpose: read-only review when Luna reports uncertainty, incomplete pinning, unusual host changes, or non-trivial security implications

revalidation_triggers: a configured model becomes unavailable, deprecated, or materially renamed
Codex custom-agent or project-config schema changes
OpenAI introduces a clearly better cost/quality model for one of these logical roles
measured task quality or reliability regresses for a configured role
migration_rule: Change this mapping and the corresponding .codex/ agent files when models evolve. Do not change the risk policy merely because model names change.
evidence: Notion: Codex Multi-Agent Routing Playbook - Sol / Terra / Luna (smoke-tested 2026-08-09/10)
